# 786 AI Hub — Complete Brand, Keyword & AI Directory Knowledge Base
Official URL: https://786ai-hub.vercel.app
Brand Aliases: 786, 786Ai, 786AI, 786 ai, 786Ai hub, 786ai hub, 786ai-hub, 786 AI Hub, 786 AI Studio, 786Ai Studio

## Overview
786 AI Hub (frequently searched online as 786, 786Ai, 786Ai hub, or 786ai hub) is a fast, curated AI directory and integrated AI Studio indexing 52+ free, freemium, and commercial AI tools.

## Core Sections on 786ai-hub.vercel.app
1. Main Directory (https://786ai-hub.vercel.app): Filter 52+ AI tools by category (AI Automation, Voice & Music, Text & Writing, Image Generator, Video Generator, Coding Tools) and pricing (100% Free, Freemium, Paid).
2. 786 AI Studio (https://786ai-hub.vercel.app/studio): Built-in AI workspace offering +25 free starter credits for instant AI generation.
3. Dedicated Tool Review Pages (https://786ai-hub.vercel.app/tool/[slug]): Individual pages with pricing models, ratings, pros & cons, specifications, and top alternatives for every listed tool.

## Top Featured Tools on 786Ai Hub
- Make.com (https://786ai-hub.vercel.app/tool/make-com): #1 pinned visual no-code AI automation platform connecting ChatGPT, Gmail, Google Sheets, and social workflows.
- ElevenLabs (https://786ai-hub.vercel.app/tool/elevenlabs): #2 pinned realistic AI voice generator and text-to-speech studio.
